summary.text: Linda Rogers is a Republican who has represented Indiana Senate District 11, which covers portions of Elkhart and St. Joseph counties, since 2018.
She chairs the Pensions and Labor Committee and owns Juday Creek Golf Course.

paragraphs.text: According to her Indiana Senate Republican biography, Rogers earned a B.S. in mathematics in secondary education from Central Michigan University and is president of Nugent Builders.

She was president of the Home Builders Association of St. Joseph Valley in 2006-2007 and of the Indiana Builders Association in 2015, and served as president of the National Golf Course Owners Association from 2011 to 2013.
She also serves on the Education and Career Development, Elections, Family and Children Services, and Tax and Fiscal Policy committees.
The page lists her family as her husband, Mike, a daughter, Michelle Wittig, and two grandchildren.
